Chemical Storage & Inventory

CHEMICAL STORAGE REQUIREMENTS:

☐ All chemicals stored by compatibility (not alphabetically)

☐ Flammables stored in approved flammable cabinets

☐ Acids stored separately from bases

☐ Oxidizers stored separately from flammables/organics

☐ Water-reactives stored away from sinks/water sources

☐ Peroxide-formers dated upon receipt and opening

☐ All containers properly labeled with contents and hazards

☐ Shelf clips/restraints on all shelves

☐ No chemicals stored on floor

☐ No chemicals stored above eye level on high shelves

☐ Secondary containment for liquids

☐ Chemical inventory maintained and updated

HAZARDOUS WASTE MANAGEMENT:

☐ Waste containers properly labeled with "Hazardous Waste"

☐ Waste containers labeled with contents and accumulation start date

☐ Containers kept closed except when adding waste

☐ Incompatible wastes segregated

☐ Secondary containment provided

☐ Satellite accumulation area inspected weekly

☐ Waste disposed of through authorized channels

☐ No sink disposal of hazardous chemicals

Laboratory Safety Checklist

GENERAL SAFETY:

☐ No food or drink in laboratory

☐ No mouth pipetting (mechanical pipettors used)

☐ Lab coats worn when handling hazardous materials

☐ Appropriate gloves available and worn

☐ Safety goggles (not just glasses) worn for hazardous procedures

☐ Closed-toe shoes required (no sandals/flip-flops)

☐ Long hair and loose clothing secured

☐ No unauthorized experiments

☐ No working alone after hours (buddy system)

☐ Chemical Hygiene Plan posted and accessible

☐ Emergency procedures posted

☐ SDS accessible (online or binder)

HOUSEKEEPING:

☐ Work surfaces clean and decontaminated

☐ Aisles and exits clear

☐ No clutter on bench tops

☐ Sink areas clean

☐ Equipment labeled and maintained

☐ Waste disposed of properly

☐ Chemical storage areas organized

☐ No blocked access to safety equipment

EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

☐ Emergency phone numbers posted

☐ Spill procedures posted and understood

☐ Spill kit stocked and accessible

☐ First aid kit stocked

☐ Emergency evacuation routes posted

☐ Evacuation procedures practiced

☐ Emergency contact list current

STUDENT TRAINING:

☐ All students completed lab safety training

☐ Safety training documented

☐ Students signed safety acknowledgment form

☐ Specific training for hazardous procedures

☐ Emergency procedures reviewed with students

☐ PPE requirements communicated

☐ Prohibited activities communicated
